title: alert_rule and alert_rule_version schemas must stay in sync; new migrations require testdata/migration_ids.txt entry
answers: How do I add a new DB migration for alert_rule
Migration test fails after adding a new AddMigration call
alert_rule_version out of sync with alert_rule schema
what files change together for an alert_rule column change
body:
alert_rule_version is a versioned shadow copy of alert_rule (used to track rule history); any column type/definition change applied to alert_rule must be applied identically to alert_rule_version in the same PR, or version records can fail to save or get silently truncated.
When registering a new migration in pkg/services/sqlstore/migrations/migrations.go (OSSMigrations.AddMigration), the migration's name string must also be appended to pkg/services/sqlstore/migrations/testdata/migration_ids.txt in the same order, or the migration ID snapshot test fails.
applies: Any change to Grafana alerting DB schema (alert_rule/alert_rule_version) or any new migration added via OSSMigrations.AddMigration
